title: RelativeGeneralizedSmoothConvex.lean

problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimization of a differentiable convex function f on a real Hilbert space. A minimizer x⋆ exists with ‖x0−x⋆‖≤R and f(x0)−f(x⋆)≤Δ. Strong convexity is not assumed.

oracle.label: inexact_gradient
oracle.details: A query x returns g satisfying ‖g−∇f(x)‖≤α‖∇f(x)‖ for every history and seed. Replies may be biased and history-dependent; neither independence nor unbiasedness is required. No function values are supplied.

distinctive_assumptions.label: generalized_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: The gradient is continuous. Whenever ‖∇f(x+θ(y−x))‖≤M for every θ∈[0,1], one has ‖∇f(x)−∇f(y)‖≤(L0+L1M)‖x−y‖. Public parameters satisfy L0>0 and L1≥0; no second differentiability is assumed.

distinctive_assumptions.label: relative_error
distinctive_assumptions.details: The public error tolerance satisfies 0≤α≤1/100. The relative gradient-error bound holds pointwise for every query, history, and seed, including adversarially dependent errors.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: The ambient space is an arbitrary complete real inner-product space, without a finite-dimensional restriction. E, x0, L0, L1, R, Δ, α, and ε are public, with R, Δ, ε>0; f and its gradient are hidden instance data.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: Return a point x with f(x)−f(x⋆)≤ε for a global minimizer x⋆, within the supplied fixed budget of inexact-gradient oracle calls.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/RelativeGeneralizedSmoothConvex.lean: spec.successful; LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence, executeWithTrace; supplied extracted result budget.

accuracy.label: almost_sure
accuracy.details: The output objective-gap guarantee holds almost surely under the joint law of algorithm and oracle seeds.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The setup combines gradient-dependent generalized smoothness with uniformly bounded, potentially adversarial relative gradient error in an arbitrary Hilbert space, and requires almost-sure objective accuracy within a fixed oracle budget.

descriptionHtml:
Convex Minimization with Relative Errors

We consider minimizing a continuously differentiable convex function f:E→R on a real Hilbert space E. The function f is (L0,L1)-smooth, with L0>0 and L1≥0. A given point x0∈E has distance at most R>0 and objective gap at most Δ>0 from a global minimizer x⋆. At x, the oracle returns g∈E with ∥g−∇f(x)∥≤α∥∇f(x)∥, where 0≤α≤1/100; replies may depend on the query history. For ε>0, the goal is x¯∈E satisfying f(x¯)−f(x⋆)≤ε almost surely under P, the joint law of algorithm and oracle randomness.

The optimization problem is minx∈Ef(x). The norm ∥⋅∥ is induced by the inner product on E. The algorithm receives E, L0, L1, R, Δ, x0, α, and ε.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Convexity and differentiability). The function f is Fréchet differentiable everywhere on E, its gradient ∇f:E→E is continuous, and f((1−t)x+ty)≤(1−t)f(x)+tf(y),x,y∈E,t∈[0,1].

Assumption 2 (Generalized smoothness). For every x,y∈E and M∈R satisfying ∥∇f(x+θ(y−x))∥≤Mfor all θ∈[0,1], we have ∥∇f(x)−∇f(y)∥≤(L0+L1M)∥x−y∥.

Assumption 3 (Initial distance and objective gap). There exists x⋆∈E such that f(x⋆)≤f(x)for every x∈E,∥x0−x⋆∥≤R,f(x0)−f(x⋆)≤Δ.

Assumption 4 (Relative oracle error). Queries may be made at any x∈E. For every finite query–reply history h and every realization z of the oracle randomness used for the reply, the returned vector g(h,x,z)∈E satisfies ∥g(h,x,z)−∇f(x)∥≤α∥∇f(x)∥. The oracle randomness may be dependent across calls and is independent of the algorithm’s randomness.

After the allotted oracle calls, the output x¯∈E must satisfy f(x¯)−f(x⋆)≤εP-a.s. Here x⋆ is a fixed global minimizer, independent of the randomness defining P.

comparisonHtml:
Convex differentiable f on a real Hilbert space has continuous gradient and satisfies ∥∇f(x)−∇f(y)∥≤(L0+L1M)∥x−y∥ whenever ∥∇f∥≤M on [x,y]. A minimizer x⋆ satisfies ∥x0−x⋆∥≤R and f(x0)−f(x⋆)≤Δ; L0,R,Δ,ε>0, L1≥0. Every possibly history-dependent reply obeys ∥v−∇f(x)∥≤α∥∇f(x)∥, 0≤α≤1/100. Target: f(xN)−f(x⋆)≤ε on every oracle path.

import LongTails.Setups.GeneralizedSmoothAndConvex

open Set

namespace LongTails.Setups.RelativeGeneralizedSmoothConvex

open OracleTemplate

structure Public extends GeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.Public where
  α : ℝ
  ε : ℝ

structure Instance (p : Public) where
  f : p.E → ℝ
  grad : p.E → p.E

abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Public
  Public := Public
  Instance := Instance
  Query p := p.E
  Reply p := p.E
  Output p := p.E
  publicInput p := p
  valid p := 0 < p.L0 ∧ 0 ≤ p.L1 ∧ 0 < p.R ∧ 0 < p.Δ ∧
    0 ≤ p.α ∧ p.α ≤ 1 / 100 ∧ 0 < p.ε
  admissible p I oracle :=
    (∀ history seed x, ‖oracle.answer history (0, x) seed - I.grad x‖ ≤ p.α * ‖I.grad x‖) ∧
    ConvexOn ℝ univ I.f ∧
    (∀ x, HasGradientAt I.f (I.grad x) x) ∧
    Continuous I.grad ∧
    (∀ x y M, (∀ θ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖I.grad (x + θ • (y - x))‖ ≤ M) →
      ‖I.grad x - I.grad y‖ ≤ (p.L0 + p.L1 * M) * ‖x - y‖) ∧
    (∃ xstar, IsMinOn I.f univ xstar ∧ ‖p.x0 - xstar‖ ≤ p.R ∧
      I.f p.x0 - I.f xstar ≤ p.Δ)
  successful p I output P :=
    ∃ xstar, IsMinOn I.f univ xstar ∧
      ∀ᵐ ω ∂(P : MeasureTheory.Measure _), I.f (output ω) - I.f xstar ≤ p.ε

end LongTails.Setups.RelativeGeneralizedSmoothConvex
